Bahrain Civil Service Salary Scale Calculator

Choose your table, grade and rank, add the allowances you know, and see your gross and net salary and your basic after the annual increment.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Calculate your salary from the table

Two rates: single, and married or supporting children; the amounts are in an annex to the regulation.

Bahrain government salary tables

Each grade has a minimum (rank 0) followed by 15 ranks with a fixed increment, so basic pay = minimum + rank × increment. The tables are published in the Civil Service Bureau's open data with no effective date, and we found no decision amending them up to November 2026.

Allowances

  • Transport: BHD 20 a month, not combined with the car allowance.
  • Living-standard improvement: BHD 85 or 100 for some employees since June 2023 (Decision 45/2023), replacing 50 and 60, and not paid to senior posts. We have not read the annex that sets who gets which, so choose the amount on your payslip.
  • Social allowance: two rates, for single staff and for married, divorced or widowed staff supporting children (Decision 3/2018). The amounts are in an annex whose text we could not find, so enter yours from your payslip.
  • Car allowance: for general grade 5 and above, BHD 60 in full or 30 reduced, up to 80 with extra kilometres, and 300 for an undersecretary, 250 for an assistant undersecretary and 80 for a director.

Annual increment

One rank in the same grade is added on 1 January after a year from appointment or the last increment, subject to at least satisfactory performance and six months' actual service in the year, without passing the top of the grade. It is withheld after unpaid leave or suspension of more than six months in the year.

Deductions

7% of basic salary only is deducted for the pension since 2023 (Law 13/2022), the government pays 20%, and 1% goes to unemployment insurance. Allowances are outside the base. Estimate your pension with the Bahrain pension calculator.

Examples:
General, grade 6, minimum: 420 + 20 transport = 440, pension 29.400 and unemployment 4.200, so the known part nets BHD 406.400 before the living and social allowances. After the annual increment the basic becomes 430.
Executive, grade 3, rank 4: 1,300 + 4 × 43 = 1,472, pension 103.040.
Educational, grade 1, minimum: 328, pension 22.960.

Frequently asked questions

What is a Bahraini government employee's salary?

In the general jobs table (36 hours a week) basic pay runs from BHD 322 at grade 2 to 1,083 at the top of grade 10, the executive table from 847 to 3,901, and the educational table from 328 to 1,931. Add BHD 20 transport, the 85 or 100 living-standard allowance for some employees, and the social allowance.

How much is the annual increment for Bahraini government employees?

One rank in the same grade, added on 1 January after a year from appointment or the last increment, subject to at least satisfactory performance and six months' actual service in the year. It ranges from BHD 5 at general grade 2 to 86 at executive grade 7, and stops at the top of the grade (rank 15).

How much is the living-standard improvement allowance in Bahrain?

BHD 85 or 100 a month for some employees under Prime Minister's Decision 45/2023, in force from June 2023, replacing 50 and 60. It is not paid to senior posts, and who gets which amount is set in an annex to the regulation.

How much pension is deducted from a Bahraini government salary?

7% of basic salary only since 2023 (Law 13/2022), with the government paying 20%, plus 1% for unemployment insurance. Allowances are outside the contribution base.

What is the minimum government salary in Bahrain?

The Civil Service Bureau said in February 2026 that minimum monthly pay in the public sector is BHD 402, covering basic pay, the social allowance and the living-standard allowance. The lowest basic in the general table is BHD 322.

How much are the transport and car allowances in Bahrain?

The transport allowance is BHD 20 a month, not combined with the car allowance and not paid if the employer provides transport. The car allowance for general grade 5 and above is 60 in full or 30 reduced, up to 80, and 300 for an undersecretary, 250 for an assistant undersecretary and 80 for a director.
